model_annotation:
The image presents two vertically stacked line plots corresponding to different training sets. The plots appear to share an x-axis, which is labeled "Steps" beneath the top plot, indicating a linear progression over time. Vertical tick marks are present at regular intervals, but numerical labels and the total range are obscured and not visible. The y-axes for both plots lack labels, units, and numerical values, displaying only horizontal grid lines that imply a linear scale.

The top plot compares the performance of two configurations on an easy set. A dark teal solid line without markers represents "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," accompanied by a light teal shaded region. It begins at the lowest point on the left side of the plot, ascends sharply, reaches its maximum relative height near the middle of the x-axis, and then fluctuates while maintaining a relatively high level towards the right edge. A dark red solid line without markers, depicting "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" and paired with a light red shaded region, begins slightly above the teal line's starting position. It ascends more gradually, briefly remaining below the teal line before establishing an upward trend that ultimately surpasses it, concluding at a higher position on the right side.

The bottom plot, centered under the title "Hard Training Set," illustrates the performance of the configurations under more difficult conditions. "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" is shown as a dark teal solid line without markers. It starts near the bottom left, rises very slightly, and then sharply drops below the visible y-axis limit very early along the x-axis progression. "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" is represented by a dark red solid line without markers, featuring a light red shaded region. Originating from a starting point higher than the teal line, it exhibits an initial steep rise and maintains a steady, fluctuating upward trajectory across the entirety of the x-axis, reaching its peak near the far right edge of the plot.
